run_clrs_training: run training of one or more algorithmic tasks from CLRS using the main entry point
create_samplers: create samplers for training validation and testing across multiple algorithms and sample sizes
make_sampler: create a sampler with given options for a specific algorithm split and batch size
collect_and_eval: collect batches of output and hint predictions and evaluate them against ground truth
download_dataset: download the CLRS30 dataset from GCP if it is not already present locally
